mediaItem.itemTitle: Wrongful Conviction Podcasts PSA - What to Do When Stopped by the Police (I
mediaItem.summaryNotes: This episode of "Wrongful Conviction with Jason Flom" features Jason Flom and Robbie Achadri from "Undisclosed" discussing the crucial legal rights of undocumented immigrants when interacting with law enforcement.  They emphasize that constitutional protections, including the right to remain silent and the right to refuse searches, apply to everyone regardless of immigration status. The hosts advise undocumented individuals to clearly state their right to remain silent, to not volunteer their immigration status, and to not consent to searches. They stress the importance of understanding and exercising these rights to protect oneself legally, particularly due to potential immigration consequences from legal issues.  The episode serves as an educational resource, encouraging listeners to know and utilize their rights in police encounters. Listeners are directed to "Undisclosed" and "Wrongful Conviction" podcasts for further information.
